continuity: The Western Heaven Demon Lord's sword was broken and his hand was badly wounded by Taekyung's initial Heavenly Strike, but he remains alive and capable of continuing the fight.
Taekyung can use his inventory to store White Flame during an attack and can spend System points to increase his Agility and Strength mid-battle.
Taekyung gained sixty System points by absorbing EXP from approximately a dozen restrained underground-prison inmates; the Heavenly Power Demon was excluded.
A direct exchange with the Western Heaven Demon Lord's Sword Force remains dangerous because of the Demon Lord's superior enlightenment and realm.
Cheongpung remains alive at Supreme Peak and is fighting First Fiend during the Dark Heaven assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan.
plot: Jin Taekyung's Heavenly Strike clashes with the Western Heaven Demon Lord's Sword Force, breaking the Demon Lord's sword and injuring his hand without defeating him. The Demon Lord recognizes Taekyung as an unusually powerful Peak master and attempts to recruit him, but Taekyung rejects the offer and the two resume their battle.

Taekyung invests thirty points each into Agility and Strength, stores White Flame in his inventory as the Demon Lord reaches for it, and follows with Flame Divine Palm and Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist. The combined attack drives the Demon Lord into the underground prison wall, but he survives and reveals that his apparent collapse was partly an act. Taekyung explains that he gained sixty points by absorbing EXP from the restrained prisoners, excluding the Heavenly Power Demon.

active_continuity: Dark Heaven has effectively won the assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan, while fighting continues in the ruined Family Head's Hall.
Tang Sadok is alive but gravely wounded and captive on a hill overlooking the destroyed Tang Clan.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord remains alive in the underground prison after fighting Jin Taekyung; his sword is broken and his hand is wounded, but the battle is unresolved.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord seeks the Myriad-Poison Ring and intends to deliver Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Jeok Cheongang alive to the Blood Lord.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and the Divine Physician remains in the underground prison.
Taekyung can store White Flame in his inventory during combat and spend System points to raise his attributes.
Taekyung gained sixty System points from the restrained prisoners in the underground prison, excluding the Heavenly Power Demon.
Cheongpung is alive, has reached Supreme Peak through his manifestation of Sword Force, and is fighting First Fiend.
Cheongpung and Taekyung recognize each other as friends and true martial rivals.
open_questions: What is the outcome of Taekyung's fight with the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
Can Cheongpung survive his fight with First Fiend?
Can the Tang Clan's remaining forces protect Tang Sadok and the Divine Physician?
What will the Blood Lord do when the Western Heaven Demon Lord brings the survivors or reports the battle?
Can Jeok Cheongang recover before Dark Heaven captures the underground prison?
